name: Fayaadh Dhansay
bio: A co-founder of Alpha Crest, he brings a focused and analytical approach to our team. His professional background as a Biokineticist primed him with a strong foundation in understanding complex systems and optimizing performance.

During his career, he has had considerable success while working with top 10 ATP tennis players and traveling extensively on the ATP tour, including multiple visits to prestigious events like Wimbledon and the ATP World Tour Finals. This experience, which honed his ability to analyze intricate details and identify avenues for improvement, naturally extended his interest to financial markets.

While he’s explored various areas like equities, forex, and warrants, it’s the dynamic cryptocurrency space where he’s chosen to concentrate his efforts, recognizing its unique potential. Fayaadh’s methodical way of looking at how things operate, pinpointing areas that could be improved, and then working to implement practical solutions, has been integral in developing the core of the Alpha Crest trading system.

Beyond his professional life, Fayaadh is an avid runner and padel player, reflecting his continued dedication to strategy and performance. He finds his greatest motivation and support in his family, especially his parents, brothers, wife and two kids, who are central to his life. His experience in leading his own Biokinetics practice, combined with his broad background, means he brings valuable leadership and organizational skills to the Alpha Crest team, helping to guide our approach to managing digital assets.
